newsitem.title: USA: Factory Card Q3 sales rise yields profit.
newsitem.headline: Factory Card Q3 sales rise yields profit.

text.p: Factory Card Outlet Corp said Thursday higher sales helped the company post a profit in the third quarter ended March 29 compared to a loss one year ago.

The company reported net income of $242,365, or $0.03 a share, versus a loss of $461,945, or $0.09, in the same period last year. Sales increased to $30.9 million from $21.7 million in the third quarter of 1996.
Factory Card Outlet, which expects to end its fiscal year June 29 with 140 total stores, also said it plans to 50 superstores in the next fiscal year.
Additionally, 128 stores have been converted to a point-of-sale system and the rest will be converted by the end of the month, the company said.
Factory Card Outlet operates a chain of party supply and greeting card stores.
Its shares were up 1/8 Thursday at 9.
